Brown County logs 12 bookings the week ending Oct. 4
Records show 12 bookings in Brown County, Ind., in the week ending Oct. 4, with Other accounting for the largest share.
Thursday, Oct 8
By P. K. Curran
Brown County logged 12 bookings in the week ending Oct. 4, with the Other category accounting for the largest share of bookings.
Other accounted for 58.3% of bookings, while Drug and Property each accounted for 16.7%.
Booking records reflect activity as of publication; late-arriving records may not be included.
